metaTitle: About Rerun: The Company Behind Your AI Coworkers
metaDescription: Rerun builds AI Coworkers that run on your ChatGPT or Claude plan. Open source, self-hostable, operated by Reunit SA in Luxembourg.
headline: We build the coworkers we wanted to hire.
lede: Rerun gives a team AI Coworkers for sales, support, marketing and admin. They work in your own apps, on your ChatGPT or Claude plan, included credits or your own API key.

mission.label: Why Rerun
mission.title: Hand over the work, not a workflow.
mission.first: Most AI tools ask you to draw a flow chart or to sit in a chat. A Coworker takes a job instead: it reads what your team wrote down, opens your apps on its own screen, works on schedule, and stops to ask before anything consequential.
mission.second: A small team should be able to hire that help in minutes, invite everyone at no extra cost, and keep it running while the laptop is shut.

machine.title: A machine per workspace
machine.body: Each workspace gets a machine of its own, hosted in Germany. Your Coworkers run there day and night, apart from every other customer.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.body: Rerun is open source under the AGPL-3.0 license. Read the code, follow every change, or host it on your own server.

yourModel.title: Your model, your plan
yourModel.body: Coworkers run on the ChatGPT or Claude plan you already pay for, on the credits a plan includes, or on your own API key.

company.label: The company
company.title: Operated from Luxembourg.
company.body: Rerun is built and operated by Reunit SA, a société anonyme registered in Luxembourg, at 177 Rue de Luxembourg, L-8077 Bertrange.
